_doc: A DRV8825 stepper driver module on the StepStick footprint, as made by Pololu (Rs = 0.100 ohm). Pololu's figures are spec; the pin order is community, and clone boards are community until measured. It has no logic supply pin: the FAULT pin sits where the A4988 has VDD. Board in the x-y plane, the header rows along x.
name: drv8825

motor_voltage_max.rule: Most motor supply (VMOT). Long leads and low-ESR capacitors can spike past it

logic_voltage_min.rule: Least high level on RESET and SLEEP. There is no logic supply: the board works with 3.3 V and 5 V systems

logic_voltage_max.rule: Most high level on RESET and SLEEP

current_bare.rule: Continuous per coil, about, with no heat sink or moving air

current_cooled.rule: Most per coil, with sufficient added cooling (the chip alone is rated 2.5 A at 24 V and 25 degrees C)

sense_resistor.rule: The board's sense resistors, R2 and R3

vref_formula.rule: The current limit from the voltage on the trimmer. In full step each coil carries about 0.7 of the limit

vref_gain.rule: Limit per volt of Vref: 0.5 V sets 1 A

microsteps.rule: Full down to thirty-second, set with MODE0, MODE1 and MODE2

max_microsteps.rule: The finest division of a full step

thermal_shutdown.rule: The chip stops above this temperature, typically (150 at least, 180 at most)

pin_pitch.rule: Pin spacing along a header row (0.1 in)

row_spacing.rule: Between the two header rows (0.5 in)

pin_count.rule: Pins in all, eight to a row

body_width.rule: Board length along the header rows

pinout.value: EN M0 M1 M2 RST SLP STEP DIR | VMOT GND B2 B1 A1 A2 FLT GND
pinout.rule: The two rows, each from one end to the other: as the A4988, with FAULT in place of VDD. Compare with your board's silkscreen
